notes: CBER letter on viable bone matrix HCT/P products found ineligible for section 361 regulation (fail minimal-manipulation and combination-article criteria), making them unapproved biological drugs, plus CGTP donor-eligibility failures (donors with documented sepsis, tied to an outbreak of Mycobacterium tuberculosis infections in recipients) and CGMP deviations (process validation, aseptic processing/environmental and personnel monitoring in the BSC, inadequate specifications, frozen sterility samples). The letter names the products with an internal inconsistency: 'Cellular Fiber Matrix (CFM)/Excel Viable Bone Matrix (EFM)' appears verbatim even though a footnote says the prior name of CFM was 'Excel Fiber Matrix'; both verbatim variants are included. linked_to_complaints is false because the TB outbreak is tied to donor eligibility screening, not organisms matched to consumer-complaint samples.

expected.company: Berkeley Biologics, LLC, previously operating as Elutia, Inc. – Orthobiologics Business Unit, formerly Aziyo Biologics, Inc.
